en.headline: Happy Valley vegetable stall reports tabby cat Garlic missing
en.dek: Staff at a produce shop on Tsap Tseung Street told police the four-year-old neutered cat was last seen Wednesday evening; an AirTag ping pointed to Tuen Mun early Thursday.
body: Staff at a vegetable stall on Tsap Tseung Street in Happy Valley reported to police this morning that their tabby cat, known as Garlic, had gone missing.

The shopkeeper said the four-year-old neutered cat, with black-to-brown tiger stripes, a white chest and white paws, was last seen in the shop at about 8pm on Wednesday. When staff returned to open the premises at 4am on Thursday there was no sign of the animal. A tracker on its beige collar with a green tag later showed a location hit on San On Street in Tuen Mun at about 1am.

Police attended and began reviewing nearby CCTV. The owner has appealed publicly for information and asked anyone who spots the cat not to try to grab it but to call the numbers provided. A reward is offered.

zh.headline: 跑馬地菜檔花貓「蒜頭」失蹤 飼主報警尋貓
zh.dek: 集祥街菜檔職員今早報案，指約四歲已絕育花貓昨晚仍在店內，今晨不見蹤影；項圈追蹤器凌晨一度顯示屯門位置。
body: 跑馬地集祥街一間菜檔今早報案，指店內飼養的花貓「蒜頭」失蹤。
職員表示，這隻約四歲、已絕育、背部有黑至棕色虎紋、胸口及爪子白色的花貓，昨晚約八時仍在店內。今晨四時開門時不見其蹤影。其米色項圈綠色圓牌內的追蹤裝置，凌晨約一時曾顯示屯門新安街位置。
警方到場並翻查附近閉路電視。飼主已在網上公開呼籲，若發現貓隻請勿強行捕捉，並致電提供的電話號碼，備有報酬。
